comparisons.peer_summary: Effective in Q2 2024, JPMorganChase combined its former Corporate & Investment Bank and Commercial Banking segments to form the Commercial & Investment Bank (CIB), resulting in three reportable segments: Consumer & Community Banking (CCB), CIB, and Asset & Wealth Management (AWM), with remaining activities in Corporate.
comparisons.comparison: Both companies disclose their business segment structures, but they differ in granularity and specific segment names regarding wealth management. Goldman Sachs identifies 'Asset & Wealth Management' as a segment where it raises deposits via Marcus. JPMorgan Chase, having reorganized in Q2 2024, also reports 'Asset & Wealth Management' (AWM) as a reportable segment, though its disclosure focuses on the structural change (combining CIB and Commercial Banking) rather than specific deposit-raising vehicles within AWM.
